Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Save every open FileMaker file of a multi-file solution as XML into one timestamped export folder, together with a Summary.xml manifest.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: FLOW: 1. Lists the open files (DatabaseNames, flagging any whose window is hidden or missing, which Select Window cannot bring forward; those are skipped and left out of Summary.xml) and asks whether they all belong to a single solution: export all files, only the current file, or cancel. 2. Asks for the solution name (one name for the whole batch). The HTML viewer (fm-saxml --html) and WebMCP (--webmcp) are on by default; to change that, edit $buildHtmlViewer and $buildWebMcpViewer in the configuration at the top of the script. 3. Checks that the companion server answers (GET /health); if not, offers to export anyway (the conversion is then skipped with the usual message). 4. For each open file: tells the companion it starts (POST /progress, file_start), runs Save a Copy as XML (with Include details for analysis tools) into one timestamped folder, SaXML_<file>_<date>_<time>, in FileMaker's temporary folder (Get ( TemporaryPath ); FileMaker deletes it on quit), then reports file_done; after the last file it reports done. Progress calls are best effort: short timeouts, errors ignored, and the first failure turns them off for the rest of the run, so the export never waits on the companion. 5. When more than one file was selected, writes Summary.xml into that folder: one entry for every file with a window, including the ones whose export fails (file name, host or folder, expected XML path, export time, generator="agentic-fm"; format in fm-saxml docs/manifest.md). fm-saxml compares it with the folder, so a failed export is reported as missing. 6. Hands the folder to the companion server: one POST /convert (solution name, folder path, html, webmcp) that returns a job ID at once, then polls GET /convert/<job id> every second (30 minutes at most) until the job is done, showing the stage and file N of M in the window title. No long request. 7. Shows which files were exported and which failed, and the conversion result or error. REQUIREMENTS: - Full Access privileges in every open file (needed by Save a Copy as XML) - FileMaker Pro 26 or later (Include details for analysis tools) - The companion server running on this machine (agent/scripts/launchers/start_companion.cmd on Windows, start_companion.sh on Mac), started with the Python that has fm-saxml installed (the harness .venv); agentic-fm 2fb663a or later for the html and webmcp switches; agentic-fm f6fab25 or later and fm-saxml 0.6.9 or later for progress (an older companion or fm-saxml still converts, without progress) PARAMETERS: none RETURNS: nothing

Step.Text: Viewer switches sent to the companion's /convert (fm-saxml --html and --webmcp). Both are on by default; set either to False to leave that part out. WebMCP is a layer of the HTML viewer, so $buildWebMcpViewer = True builds the HTML viewer even when $buildHtmlViewer is False.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Companion server address (it binds to 127.0.0.1, so it runs on this machine). Used by every call below.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Progress reporting (POST /progress) is best effort: short timeouts, errors ignored. $progressOff turns it off for the rest of the run after the first failed call, so a stopped companion costs at most one timeout.

Step.Text: MARK: Confirm open files

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Build the list shown to the user first, flagging any open file that has no visible window to export from (hidden windows cannot be selected, so the file is skipped and left out of Summary.xml)

Step.name: # (comment)

Step.Text: Not a single solution: narrow the export to the current file instead of asking the user to close the other files

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Export all: keep only the files that have a selectable window, so Summary.xml and the export loop never include the others

Reusing a name replaces its previous conversion.¶¶HTML viewer: " & If ( $buildHtmlViewer or $buildWebMcpViewer ; "on" ; "off" ) & "¶WebMCP: " & If ( $buildWebMcpViewer ; "on" ; "off" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Read one timestamp and derive the folder name and both Summary.xml attributes from it, so a run that crosses midnight cannot produce a mismatched date and time

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Replicates a FileMaker Pro 26 multi-file folder export (every XML plus Summary.xml in one folder) under FileMaker's temporary folder (Get ( TemporaryPath ), which has no path prefix, so the filewin:/filemac: prefix is added). Creating the (empty) Summary.xml with Create folders On also creates the folder itself.

Step.Text: A single file needs no Summary.xml: the placeholder above only existed to create the folder, so delete it

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Save a Copy as XML targets a window: use the window already confirmed selectable for this file

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Native path for Summary.xml: WinPath (2) on Windows, POSIX (1) on Mac (Get ( SystemPlatform ) = -2 is Windows). Add the filewin:/filemac: prefix when $output has none, or the conversion returns "?"

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: File/@path for Summary.xml, from this file's own location: the host name for a hosted file, the containing folder (native path, trailing separator) for a local file. Empty when its window cannot be selected.

Step.name: # (comment)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Summary.xml lists every file with a window, including failed exports (their XML is simply absent from the folder, which fm-saxml reports as missing), in the format expected by the fm-saxml converter. It is written next to the exported XML files.

Value.Calculation: Substitute ( "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>" & ¶ & "<FMPReport CreationDate=\"" & $today & "\" CreationTime=\"" & GetAsTime ( $now ) & "\" type=\"Summary\" generator=\"agentic-fm\" version=\"2.3.0.0\" membercount=\"" & $fileCount & "\">" & ¶ & $summaryFiles & ¶ & "</FMPReport>" & ¶ ; ¶ ; Char ( 10 ) )
Let ( ~error = Get ( LastError ) ; If ( ~error ≠ 0 ; "Write to Data File failed (error " & ~error & ")" ; "" ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Convert with the companion

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Hand the export folder to the companion server: one POST /convert for the whole batch (one solution name), which returns a job ID at once, then poll GET /convert/<job id> every second until the job is done. Insert from URL never waits on fm-saxml, so there is no long request and no --max-time. The companion binds to 127.0.0.1, so it must run on this machine.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: export_path is a native path (WinPath on Windows, POSIX on Mac). Several files: the folder (Summary.xml inside), without its trailing separator. One file: that file's own XML, since it has no Summary.xml.

Start it at " & $companionUrl & " (agent/scripts/launchers/start_companion.cmd on Windows, start_companion.sh on Mac), then convert the export folder above, or export again." ; "" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: A job ID is 12 characters. A 409 (this solution is already converting) also carries the running job's ID, so it is polled like a new job. Any other answer has no job_id (JSONGetElement gives "?") and its error is shown.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Poll every second until the job is no longer queued or running. A conversion takes seconds to several minutes; give up after 30 minutes (the job keeps running in the companion).

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: The window title shows the conversion's progress while polling; $titleNow tracks the title it has now, and the original title is put back after the loop

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Still queued or running: show the stage and file N of M from the job's progress block (an fm-saxml without --progress leaves it empty, and the title says working)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: A window the user closed during the pause can't be renamed: keep the last title that worked

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: The job is done (or polling stopped): turn its state into the text for the final dialog. A 404 (the companion restarted, so it forgot the job) has no state and lands on the last line.
